title: Phase 1: ScopeIdSyntax + ScopeMode / ResourceFileSchema (core/shared/viaductschema)
description:
Phase 1 foundation tasks from .alucify/implementation-plan.md (v2). Single work stream in core/shared/viaductschema.

## Task 1.1 — ScopeIdSyntax utility
- New: core/shared/viaductschema/src/main/kotlin/.../ScopeIdSyntax.kt
- Kotlin object with validate(id: String): Result method
- Single regex constant ([a-z]+) per AP-4 single-point syntax enforcement
- Valid IDs: "public", "internal" → success
- Invalid IDs: "Public", "123", "", "a-b" → failure with actionable message

## Task 1.2 — ScopeMode sealed interface + ResourceFileSchema
- New: ScopeMode sealed interface with ScopedMode(scopeUniverse: Set<String>, scopedSchemas: Map<String, Set<String>>) and NoScopesMode (singleton object)
- New: ResourceFileSchema data class with declaredSchemaScopes, declaredScopedSchemas, version
- Jackson serialization with sorted keys (ORDER_MAP_ENTRIES_BY_KEYS), Jackson 2.17.3
- FULL schema ID with empty scope set present by default (R-23-001)
- version field present (R-23-002)
- Scope sets sorted alphabetically (R-23-004)
- Sealed interface must compile to JVM 11-compatible bytecode

## Test coverage required (TDD)
- TS-044, TS-053 for Task 1.1
- TS-001 for Task 1.2 (IC-1 ScopeMode contract)
- ResourceFileSchema round-trip: R-23-001, R-23-002, R-23-004
- JVM 11 bytecode compatibility check for sealed interface
- Jackson ObjectMapper sorted-key configuration verified against Jackson 2.17.3 on both Gradle plugin and runtime classpaths

## Downstream test gates
- core/shared/viaductschema:test (must pass)
- core/shared/graphql:test (compile-time consumer)
- No production-code behavior change yet — these are pure additions

## Constraints
- Branch: feature/scoped-schema-build-time-validation (merge target)
- Local commits only — no push
- TDD: write failing tests first
- Save test output to /tmp/* (or harness output files) before analysis
- Run :shared:viaductschema:test first, then expand if needed
closeReason: Phase 1 merged: ScopeIdSyntax + ScopeMode + ResourceFileSchema with 27 new tests (13+6+8). Branch overstory/phase1-builder/viaduct-747e merged clean into feature/scoped-schema-build-time-validation. Verified per trust-and-verify: tests re-run green, content spot-checked (real assertions, error-message content asserted), JVM target=17/major=61 (project standard, not the spec's assumed 11). Both downstream gates :viaductschema:test and :graphql:test PASS.

title: Phase 2.1+2.2: Gradle DSL scope-declaration extension + A.8 tightening
description:
Bundle of Tasks 2.1 and 2.2 from .alucify/implementation-plan.md (v2). Foundation for Task 2.4 orchestration.

## Task 2.1 — Gradle DSL extension on ViaductApplicationExtension
- File: gradle-plugins/common/src/main/kotlin/viaduct/gradle/ViaductApplicationExtension.kt (MODIFY)
- Add methods: declaredSchemaScopes(Set<String>), declaredScopedSchema(id: String, scopes: Set<String>)
- Add accessor: getSchemaScopeInfo(): ScopeMode (returns NoScopesMode when never invoked, ScopedMode otherwise)
- Validate at configuration time per AP-5 fail-fast:
  - Syntax via viaduct.graphql.schema.scopes.ScopeIdSyntax.validate
  - Uniqueness of declared scope IDs (no dupes)
  - Subset: every scope in declaredScopedSchema must be in declaredSchemaScopes universe
  - On failure: throw GradleException with actionable message
- Backed by Gradle @Input properties for UP-TO-DATE / config-cache compatibility (CC-6, TS-054)
- Additive / backward compatible: never-invoked → behaviour identical to today (NoScopesMode)

Depends on Phase 1 types in com.airbnb.viaduct.shared:viaductschema (ScopeIdSyntax, ScopeMode, ScopedMode, NoScopesMode). gradle-plugins/common build.gradle.kts already has 'implementation(libs.viaduct.shared.viaductschema)' — verify.

## Task 2.2 — A.8 tightening (the only OSS-code edit in this bundle)
- File: core/shared/graphql/src/main/kotlin/viaduct/graphql/scopes/visitors/ValidateScopesVisitor.kt line 51 (EDIT)
- Current: `if (scopes != validScopes) throw DirectiveRetainedTypeScopeError(element)` — accepts ["*"] OR an enumeration of the full universe.
- Tighten: only accept the literal wildcard ["*"] for directive-used types; reject the "enumerate the whole universe" form.
- Update DirectiveRetainedTypeScopeError message to recommend ["*"].
- NO other code edits in core/shared/graphql. ZERO new ValidationRule classes. ZERO ViaductRuleSetProvider. ZERO new SPI surface (REGISTRY-9, REGISTRY-11).

## Tests required (TDD)
For 2.1 (gradle-plugins side):
- TS-002, TS-003 — scope declarations are serializable Gradle inputs, UP-TO-DATE compatible
- TS-004, TS-033, TS-035 — methods additive + backward compatible (no scope decl = identical behaviour)
- TS-032, TS-034 — plugin applies with config caching
- TS-042 — build-time declaration authority enforced
- TS-045 — invalid syntax fails build immediately at configuration time
- TS-054 — Gradle tasks configured for UP-TO-DATE + build cache
- Negative tests: duplicate scope IDs, scoped-schema scope not in universe, ScopeIdSyntax-invalid scope name, ScopeIdSyntax-invalid scoped-schema ID

For 2.2 (core/shared/graphql side):
- New tests in core/shared/graphql/src/test/kotlin/viaduct/graphql/scopes/visitors/ValidateScopesVisitorTest.kt (or a new sibling). Reuse the existing assertThrows(sdl: String) helper.
- A.8 fixture: SDL with directive-used type annotated `@scope(to: ["*"])` — PASSES (must not throw).
- A.8 fixture: SDL with directive-used type annotated `@scope(to: ["public","internal","admin"])` where universe == {public, internal, admin} — FAILS after this change with DirectiveRetainedTypeScopeError. Was passing before this change.
- Verify the error message mentions `["*"]` as the recommended fix.

## Downstream test gates (run all before reporting worker_done)
- gradle-plugins/application:test (primary)
- gradle-plugins/module:test (smoke — module plugin unchanged)
- gradle-plugins/common:test if it exists; otherwise verify common compiles
- core/shared/graphql:test (A.8 tightening hot path)
- core/shared/viaductschema:test (Phase 1 regression — unchanged)
- demoapps/starwars:test (no-scopes regression gate — must remain identical)

## Constraints

- Local commits only — no push

- Save raw gradle output to /tmp/* before analysis; pre-test ./gradlew --no-daemon if cache races appear

## Acceptance
- All new tests written FIRST, then green
- All downstream gates above pass
- A.8 tightening verified: literal ["*"] accepted, enumerated-universe rejected

title: Phase 2.4: AssembleCentralSchemaTask scope-aware build pipeline + resource file generation
description:
Task 2.4 from .alucify/implementation-plan.md (v2). Wires the build-time scope materialization, validation, and resource-file emission into the existing AssembleCentralSchemaTask. Depends on Tasks 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2 (all merged).

## Scope
- File: gradle-plugins/application/src/main/kotlin/viaduct/gradle/task/AssembleCentralSchemaTask.kt (MODIFY)
- File: gradle-plugins/application/src/main/kotlin/viaduct/gradle/ViaductApplicationPlugin.kt (MODIFY — wire extension to task)
- Possibly new sibling helper file(s) under gradle-plugins/application/src/main/kotlin/viaduct/gradle/task/ or .../scopes/
- File: gradle-plugins/application/build.gradle.kts (verify implementation deps for shared:graphql + shared:viaductschema; add if missing)

## Build pipeline (strict phase ordering per R-19-001/R-19-002)
Read getSchemaScopeInfo() from the extension.
- If NoScopesMode → existing behavior preserved exactly (no resource file, no scope materialization). Backward compat (R-20-001 — verified later in Task 4.1).
- If ScopedMode:
  Phase 1 (declarations): already validated at config time by Task 2.1
  Phase 2 (SDL @scope): invoke existing ScopedSchemaBuilder.applyScopes via ScopeDirectiveParser(validScopeNames = scopeUniverse) for every UNIQUE declared scope set. Surface SchemaScopeValidationError as GradleException.
  Phase 3 (materialize + validate each unique scope set):
    - Run graphql.GraphQL.newGraphQL(filtered).execute(IntrospectionQuery.INTROSPECTION_QUERY) and assert empty errors (R-22-003)
    - Run PostTransformDirectiveStructureValidation + PostTransformStructuralValidation (R-22-004..R-22-008)
    - Cache scope-set → materialized schema; aliases sharing a scope set reuse one materialization (R-22-002)
  Phase 4 (resource file): write META-INF/viaduct/schema-scoping.json using ResourceFileSchema + objectMapper() (sorted keys, R-23-001..R-23-005)
- Phases run in strict order; failure short-circuits and reports only current-phase error (AP-5 fail-fast)

## Resource file output
- Path: <outputDirectory>/META-INF/viaduct/schema-scoping.json
- Use ResourceFileSchema.create(declaredSchemaScopes, declaredScopedSchemas, version) — Phase 1 default-FULL injection (R-23-001) and sorted keys (R-23-004) already handled
- Serialize with ResourceFileSchema.objectMapper()
- Must be a Gradle @OutputFile or covered by existing @OutputDirectory for UP-TO-DATE
- Deterministic byte-identical output for identical inputs (TS-010)

## Tests (TDD — write FAILING tests FIRST)
gradle-plugins/application/src/test/kotlin/viaduct/gradle/task/... + functional tests
- TS-005 — IC-2 transformSchema invoked per scope set
- TS-006 — IC-2 applyScopes correctness on a fixture SDL
- TS-007 — idempotent transformation: same scope set called twice → same materialized schema (cache hit, R-22-002)
- TS-008 — empty scope set materializes the full schema (FULL semantics)
- TS-009 — IC-3 writeResourceFile produces well-formed JSON
- TS-010 — deterministic output: two invocations with same inputs → byte-identical JSON
- TS-011 — sorted keys in JSON (R-23-005)
- TS-012 — sorted scope sets in JSON (R-23-004)
- TS-049 — CH-3 pipeline orchestration: multi-phase happy path + phase-3 introspection failure short-circuits
- R-22-001 — every declared unique scope set produces a materialized schema
- R-22-002 — alias IDs (multiple IDs → same scope set) share single materialization (introspect call count == unique scope sets, not total IDs)
- R-22-003 — introspection runs against each materialized schema, no errors
- R-22-004..R-22-008 — each post-transform validation step produces a passing result on the canonical fixture

Coverage demand from operator (verbatim):
- R-23-001: FULL schema ID with empty scope set present by default — assert it explicitly, not via "no exception thrown"
- R-23-002: version field present and non-empty in serialized output
- R-23-004: scope sets sorted alphabetically — assert against a fixture with deliberately unsorted input

## Backward-compat regression
- demoapps/starwars:test must remain identical (no-scopes app); no resource file generated for it
- gradle-plugins/module:test smoke
- core/shared/graphql:test unchanged

## Downstream test gates (run all before reporting worker_done)
- gradle-plugins/application:test (primary)
- gradle-plugins/module:test
- core/shared/graphql:test
- core/shared/viaductschema:test
- demoapps/starwars:test (no-scopes regression gate — MUST remain identical; if BatchResolverIntegrationTest "flake" recurs in your run, halt and ESCALATE to coordinator immediately; do not dismiss as flaky)

## Constraints
- Branch: spawned worktree branch from feature/scoped-schema-build-time-validation
- Local commits only — no push
- TDD: failing tests first, save raw output, then pass
- Save raw gradle output to /tmp/phase2.4-fail.log and /tmp/phase2.4-pass.log
- DO NOT touch core/shared/graphql sources (only call existing classes)
- DO NOT introduce ValidationRule SPI / ViaductRuleSetProvider
- ONE commit per logical change (extension wiring | phase orchestration | resource file emission | tests) so bisect works

## Acceptance
- All new tests written FIRST, then green
- All downstream gates pass without 'flaky' rationalization
- ZERO new ValidationRule classes, ZERO ViaductRuleSetProvider
- Pipeline strict-phase-ordering verified: declarations → SDL → materialize+validate → resource file
- Aliased scope IDs share materialization (verified via call count)

All downstream gates pass.

title: Tracking: BatchResolverIntegrationTest intermittent ReadTimeoutException flake in demoapps/starwars:test
description:
Intermittent flake observed in demoapps/starwars during Phase 2 trust-and-verify runs. Reproduces ~1-in-N times on full-suite invocations of `./gradlew -p demoapps/starwars test --rerun-tasks` from per-phase worktrees; isolated re-runs of just BatchResolverIntegrationTest pass every time. Failure mode: ReadTimeoutException from the embedded HTTP client.

## Observations
- Phase 0 baseline (initial single-run starwars:test): clean, 0 failures.
- Phase 1 (viaduct-747e) worker_done re-run: clean.
- Phase 2a (viaduct-659e) worker_done: builder claimed 'flaky, passes in isolation'. Coordinator force-rerun: clean (4 tests, 0 failures in JUnit XML).
- Phase 2b (viaduct-12ad) worker_done: builder ESCALATED — first full-suite run failed with ReadTimeoutException, isolated PASSED, subsequent full-suite PASSED. Coordinator force-rerun: clean.
- Operator approved Option 1 (track + verify per-phase + investigate in Phase 5).

## Causal analysis
Phase 2 changes are PURELY build-time Gradle (AssembleCentralSchemaTask + ViaductApplicationPlugin orchestration). starwars demo never invokes any scope method; NoScopesMode is explicitly preserved. There is no plausible runtime path from Phase 2 to a micronaut HTTP-timing flake.

Hypotheses for follow-up investigation in Phase 5:
1. Embedded micronaut server slow-bind under suite-wide JVM warm-up; BatchResolverIntegrationTest happens to be the first batch-resolver-heavy class to hit the freshly-bound server.
2. Test-class ordering: another class leaves a dataloader / batch-context in an unflushed state that BatchResolverIntegrationTest then collides with under timing pressure.
3. Resource contention with the rest of the suite under --rerun-tasks (cold compile + warm JVM).

## Investigation plan (deferred to Phase 5 regression triage)
- Read demoapps/starwars/src/test/kotlin/com/example/starwars/service/test/BatchResolverIntegrationTest.kt
- Check for shared mutable state across the demoapps/starwars test classes (look for static singletons / object state)
- Check embedded-server lifecycle and HTTP client timeout configuration
- Try reordering test execution to isolate the offender
- Consider raising the HTTP client read timeout if a real timing issue is confirmed (vs masking a real defect — apply test-mindset rule #3)

## Operator decision (msg-8zxrdo6oed8h thread)
Option 1 accepted: track as soft baseline caveat; do not block Phase 2+ merges; investigate at Phase 5.

## DoD
Closed when:
- Root cause identified
- Either fixed permanently OR documented baseline exception with sign-off (analogous to ACS-repo's 5 documented env-fail tests in test-mindset.md §4)
